title: VTC: add E2EE state signaling
description: Signal is cited as a design influence for E2EE but the draft defines zero E2EE fields. Jitsi has E2EE via Insertable Streams, Zoom has E2EE. At minimum add: e2eeEnabled (Boolean) on VTCCall, e2eeFingerprint (String|null) on VTCParticipant for key verification display. Full key negotiation is media-layer, but the call-state model needs to signal whether E2EE is active so clients can display the security indicator.
close_reason: Added e2eeEnabled on VTCCall and e2eeFingerprint on VTCParticipant. Recording/livestream forbidden when e2eeEnabled is true.
